environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task deployed in OU ou-abc1-restrictedworkloads. The OU has SCP 'p-restrict-dangerous-actions' attached which contains an explicit Deny on lambda:InvokeFunction, s3:GetObject (note: s3:PutObject for the specific audit bucket ARN is allowed via resource condition), iam:*, sts:AssumeRole, ec2:RunInstances, and ssm:SendCommand with condition aws:PrincipalOrgID matching. Additionally, the IAM role has permission boundary arn:aws:iam::112233445566:policy/WorkloadPermissionBoundary which denies all actions except s3:PutObject on arn:aws:s3:::app-audit-logs/eval/*, logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents, and ecr:GetAuthorizationToken. The effective permission set after SCP intersection with permission boundary means even if code execution is achieved via VM2 escape, the compromised process cannot invoke Lambda functions, read S3 objects, assume other roles, or make any lateral movement API calls. Network egress is restricted to VPC endpoints for S3 and CloudWatch Logs only (no NAT gateway, no internet route).

config.network: VPC endpoints only (s3, logs), no internet egress, no NAT
config.effective_permissions: s3:PutObject on audit bucket eval/ prefix only, logs:*, ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
